crossRefs.note: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
“Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son…
His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand and five hundred.

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

translations.web: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand and four hundred.
translations.bsb: These were the clans of Asher, and their registration numbered 53,400.
translations.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
translations.asv: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them, fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
